source_assumption_translation.reference: The same actual probability reference μ and BaseNorm.ProbabilityCone C as the original DensityInstrument.
source_assumption_translation.cells: Finite measurable pairwise-disjoint positive-reference-mass cells with μ-a.e. coverage. This generalizes literal coverage and supports the actual uniform measure on ℝ concentrated on [-1,1].
source_assumption_translation.averages: cellAverage is μ.real(cell)^−1 times the actual operator-valued Bochner cellOperator; operator is the finite indicator sum, zero on the uncovered null set.
source_assumption_translation.induced_norm: inducedNorm is the actual sSup of C.value(Tz) on the genuine C.value unit ball. Boundedness is proved from derived two-way ambient/base-norm bounds, and homogeneity proves the all-vector estimate.
source_assumption_translation.lipschitz: CellLipschitz assumes only the source induced-norm inequality for pairs within a cell, a weaker sufficient form of the global source assumption. The uniform endpoint assumes the inequality on the whole declared interval. Nonnegative L and diameter h are explicit.
source_assumption_translation.error_supremum: approximationError inserts zero to handle an empty action/state index set. approximationError_eq_sup proves equality to the literal source supremum whenever normalized action/state inputs exist. No discrepancy or averaging bound is assumed.
source_assumption_translation.uniform_case: The actual measure is UniformIntervalMoments.measure=du/2 on [-1,1]. Equal interval cells are actual Ioc(a_i,b_i) with endpoints inside the interval and common positive width h; CellDistance proves actual mass h/2 and double-distance h^3/12. The partition total mass then gives resolution h/3.
